label: input h late in the original phase (t>=6) of long sequences starting with q
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.008% of steps) that fires almost only in the original phase at steps 6-8, i.e. the last one or two original tokens of L=8/9 sequences, plus a little at the delimiter. Input token h makes up 75% of activation mass, and the first original token q makes up 61%. All of the strongest activations (0.7-1.0 of max) are h as the last original token of a sequence beginning with q. The rest is a long tail of weak activations on other tokens, mostly at the same late positions. Being a late h is necessary but far from enough: late-h steps fire only about 2% of the time (74% of mass). Adding first_tok==q lifts precision to ~26% but drops mass recall to ~37%, so the feature is a sparse conjunction that depends on more of the sequence history than these variables capture. Never fires in the copy phase or at t<5.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=q (+5.20), phase=0 & in_tok=h (+2.89), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=h (+2.89), orig1=s (+2.72), prev_tok=j (+2.66), orig1=0 (+2.62). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.16), phase=2 (-3.40), next_out=- (-3.16), orig3=3 (-2.01).
